author: sjm41
body:
* **InterPro ID / label**
IPR016161 Aldehyde/histidinol dehydrogenase
IPR016162 Aldehyde dehydrogenase, N-terminal

* **Example sequences with problematic annotation (ID + gene/protein name):**
Drosophila CG6661 (Q95TY8)

* **Description of issue**
 IPR016161 & IPR016162 are both high-level 'homologous superfamilies' and both are annotated with the high level GO term 'oxidoreductase activity (GO:0016491)', which isn't very informative.
Moreover, these signatures are found in a Drosophila pseudoenzyme (Q95TY8), therefore annotating it with an inappropriate catalytic activity term.

So, could 'oxidoreductase activity' be removed from these two InterPro signatures?
title: InterPro2GO issue: IPR016161 & IPR016162

author: tony787
body:
Hi Steven, 
Thank you for letting us know.
I have removed the GO term from these two signatures.
Changes will be visible in the next InterPro release.
Best wishes,
Toni
